meta.title: Bill Formatter — XML Ingestion to Invoice Distribution

lanes.name: Billing Operations User
lanes.hint: Admin Console / Bill Formatter Portal actions

lanes.name: Bill Formatter (DXP)
lanes.hint: Core ingestion, generation, masking, reporting engine

lanes.name: Siebel CRM
lanes.hint: Hot bill landing, notification logging, resend/reprint requests

nodes.label: Bill Run / Manual Upload Trigger
nodes.desc: Invoice XML retrieval begins from the Mediation Zone predefined input location for regular, trial and hot bills, or an authorised user performs a manual XML/ZIP upload.

nodes.label: Retrieve/Upload XML
nodes.desc: XML is retrieved from the Mediation Zone predefined location for regular, trial and hot bills, or received via authorised manual XML/ZIP upload.

nodes.label: Atomic File Write
nodes.desc: The XML file is written to a temporary location or filename, closed and verified, then renamed/moved to the final destination so no partially written file is readable downstream.

nodes.label: Batch Grouping
nodes.desc: XML files are retrieved and processed batch-wise; each collection cycle produces a single batch identifier.

nodes.label: Duplicate Prevention Check
nodes.desc: The same invoice XML file is not processed more than once.

nodes.label: Log Retrieval Status
nodes.desc: Retrieval and load status is logged for every XML file.

nodes.label: Retrieval Successful?
nodes.desc: Retrieval errors are retried per the configured retry policy; a persistent failure is raised for operational review.

nodes.label: Persistent Retrieval Failure Raised
nodes.desc: A persistent retrieval failure is raised for operational review after configured retries are exhausted.

nodes.label: Derive Invoice Type & Segment
nodes.desc: Invoice type and customer segment are derived from the loaded XML content.

nodes.label: Schema & Mandatory Data Validation
nodes.desc: XML is validated for schema conformance and mandatory billing data. Only files passing both proceed to invoice generation.

nodes.label: XML Valid?
nodes.desc: A validation failure marks the file as Failed XML with a recorded reason.

nodes.label: Failed XML — Reason Recorded
nodes.sub: BR-009, BR-010, XML Record: Failed XML
nodes.desc: The XML is marked Failed XML with the failure reason recorded and is visible in the portal for review and reprocessing after corrective action.

nodes.label: Review & Reprocess Failed XML
nodes.desc: Billing Operations reviews failed XML records in the portal and initiates reprocessing following corrective action.

nodes.label: Update Batch Statistics
nodes.desc: Batch statistics are updated to reflect successful and failed XML processing outcomes.

nodes.label: Supporting CSV Presence Check
nodes.desc: A scheduler checks every ten minutes for an expected supporting CSV; if still absent four hours after XML receipt, an alert email is issued to configured recipients.

nodes.label: Supporting CSV Missing Alert
nodes.desc: An alert email is issued to the configured recipients when the expected supporting CSV remains absent four hours after XML receipt.

nodes.label: Parse XML & Load Data
nodes.desc: Invoice Header, Invoice Summary and Invoice Detail structures are loaded from the parsed XML.

nodes.label: Generate Invoice Output
nodes.desc: PDF, XLS and CSV invoice outputs are generated for regular, trial and hot bills across Consumer Mobile, Consumer Fixed Line, Enterprise, Black, Bulk SMS and IoT segments in English and Arabic.

nodes.label: Determine Invoice Language
nodes.desc: The invoice language is determined from the language type identifier in the source data; English and Arabic templates and translation values are applied.

nodes.label: Enterprise Detailed Output (XLS/CSV)
nodes.desc: An Enterprise customer opted for the detailed bill receives an XLS output, and a call detail CSV is produced in the VFQ approved format and stored in the designated output location.

nodes.label: Bulk SMS & IoT Templates
nodes.desc: Bulk SMS invoices use the Bulk SMS invoice template and IoT invoices use the IoT invoice template, for regular, trial and hot bills.

nodes.label: Trial Bill Run Scope
nodes.desc: A trial bill run covers either an entire bill cycle or a nominated list of customers, for internal audit and bill validation only; trial batches are excluded from channel upload and never distributed to a customer.

nodes.label: Generation Successful?
nodes.desc: Invoices failing processing or generation carry a recorded failure status and reason, visible in the portal.

nodes.label: Invoice Failed — Reason Recorded
nodes.desc: Invoice generation failure carries a recorded failure status and reason, visible in the portal.

nodes.label: Reprocessing Control (Role-based)
nodes.desc: Reprocessing of a failed invoice or batch is restricted by role and the retry count is recorded.

nodes.label: Invoice Completed
nodes.desc: All invoice outputs within the batch have been generated.

nodes.label: Initiate Invoice Regeneration
nodes.desc: Billing Operations initiates an invoice regeneration request at individual invoice or batch level through the Bill Formatter application.

nodes.label: Source XML Corrected?
nodes.desc: Where the source XML has been regenerated or corrected, regeneration consumes the latest version.

nodes.label: Legacy Invoice Buffer Lookup
nodes.desc: Invoices are regenerable from the legacy XML data held in the Invoice Buffer table, including invoices generated several years previously.

nodes.label: Regenerate Invoice (Retry + Status)
nodes.desc: Invoice regeneration is supported at both individual invoice level and batch level, and includes retry and status reporting.

nodes.label: Review & Approval Switch On?
nodes.desc: Invoice review and approval before customer dispatch follows role-based access and is controlled by a switch defaulted to off.

nodes.label: Reviewer Approve/Reject
nodes.desc: Invoice reviewed and approved for despatch, or reviewed and rejected with despatch prevented and the invoice returned to Pending on regeneration.

nodes.label: Invoice Rejected
nodes.desc: Invoice reviewed and rejected; despatch is prevented and the invoice returns to Pending on regeneration.

nodes.label: Make Invoice Available to Channels
nodes.desc: Generated invoices are made available to downstream channels through the configured integration flow, with regular bill copies provided to Siebel CRM and other customer channels.

nodes.label: Hot Bill Landing Location
nodes.desc: Hot bill invoices are placed in the Siebel CRM hot bill landing location and are available in real time following generation.

nodes.label: Exclude Trial Batches from Channel Upload
nodes.desc: Trial batches are excluded from channel upload.

nodes.label: Apply Pre-Despatch Masking
nodes.desc: Customer specific masking rules are applied to the invoice before despatch through any communication channel.

nodes.label: Eligible for Email?
nodes.desc: Only successfully generated invoices are eligible for email distribution; trial invoices are never emailed.

nodes.label: Despatch Suppressed
nodes.desc: A configurable list of non-triable email addresses is maintained; despatch is not attempted for a match on the suppression list.

nodes.label: Determine Email Template
nodes.desc: The email template is determined by customer type, invoice type and language; separate templates are supported for Consumer and Enterprise in English and Arabic, with configurable dynamic fields.

nodes.label: SMTP Despatch
nodes.desc: Email is despatched through the configured SMTP service, which captures delivery feedback and provides success and failure reporting.

nodes.label: Delivered?
nodes.desc: SMTP acceptance moves the email to Sent; delivery feedback confirms Delivered or reports Failed, which is retried and resent.

nodes.label: Email Delivery Failed
nodes.sub: Email: Failed, Invoice: Failed Sending Email
nodes.desc: Delivery failed and the failure is reported in the Failed Email Report; the email is resent on retry.

nodes.label: Create CRM Notification Record
nodes.desc: A CRM notification record is created only for invoices processed for customer communication and is stored against the customer account and bill reference for servicing and audit.

nodes.label: SMS / WhatsApp / Web Delivery
nodes.desc: Invoice communication is also supported through SMS, WhatsApp Business and Web, carrying a PDF reference or an invoice URL.

nodes.label: Search Invoices & Reports
nodes.desc: Invoice and report search supports invoice type, invoice number, batch identifier, date created, language, MSISDN, product, status, email address, account number, customer type and Bill Formatter internal identifier.

nodes.label: Search Result Actions
nodes.desc: Search results support download, regenerate, reprocess and email actions, with availability determined by user role and invoice status; download formats are PDF, XML, XLS and CSV.

nodes.label: Search XML Records
nodes.desc: XML record search supports invoice type, invoice number, batch identifier and XML status, displays the latest processing status and offers Operational Log, Download XML and Regenerate XML actions.

nodes.label: Configuration Drill-Down
nodes.desc: Configuration records open in a separate window or pop-up view, and selecting a batch identifier displays the invoices belonging to that batch.

nodes.label: Admin Console — Batch/Bill Status
nodes.desc: The Admin Console displays batch identifier, date created, reference, status, number of documents and the ZIP document, with status maintained at both batch and bill level across the operational status values.

nodes.label: Batch Action Menu
nodes.desc: The batch action menu offers View Bills, View Statistics, Overall Report, Detail Report, Failed Report, Failed Email Report, Send Overall Report and Send Email.

nodes.label: Bill Action Menu
nodes.desc: The bill action menu offers Status Log, Download PDF, Download XLS, Download XML, Reprint Bill, Regenerate Document, Regenerate XML and Send Email, and applies equally to the hot bill register.

nodes.label: Download Bill (PDF/XLS/XML)
nodes.desc: A selected bill is downloadable in PDF, XLS and XML format.

nodes.label: Batch Statistics
nodes.desc: Batch statistics display successful and failed PDF generation with identifier, bill number, account number, status and reason.

nodes.label: Hot Bill Register
nodes.desc: The hot bill register displays identifier, process date, bill number, status, email address, total size, current month due, total due and the action menu.

nodes.label: Reference Data Configuration
nodes.desc: Translation, adjustment reason, benefits, flex bucket, VAS short code, plan speed and enterprise report account configuration, with import, export, effective dating, role control and product catalogue synchronisation.

nodes.label: Template & Presentation Configuration
nodes.desc: Bill template field maintenance by segment and invoice type, email and resend template configuration, bill banner configuration and overlap resolution, report template configuration and interactive PDF features.

nodes.label: Reports & Dashboards
nodes.desc: Enterprise reports, operational dashboard, batch status, overall and detailed batch reports, failed bill and failed email reports, email delivery statistics, XML processing statistics, bill run monitor and hot bill failure alerts.

nodes.label: Bill Run Monitor Alert
nodes.desc: The Bill Run Monitor email report is despatched during bill run windows at the configured interval from first batch start until the last batch or end marker.

nodes.label: Hot Bill Failure Alert
nodes.desc: Failed hot bill generation is identified and an email alert report is despatched at the configured interval.

nodes.label: Generate Masked Invoice File
nodes.desc: A separate masked invoice file is generated at the point of invoice generation for each applicable invoice; Tax Identifier, Payment Method and Phone Number are masked in accordance with the configured access policy.

nodes.label: Original Invoice Remains Immutable
nodes.desc: The original customer invoice is generated, stored and remains unchanged and immutable.

nodes.label: Privileged Role?
nodes.desc: The user role and access permission determine whether the full invoice or the masked invoice is presented; privileged roles view the full invoice and restricted roles view the masked version.

nodes.label: Present Masked Invoice
nodes.desc: Restricted roles view the masked invoice version.

nodes.label: Present Full Invoice
nodes.desc: Privileged roles view the full invoice.

nodes.label: Agent Copy / Customer Copy Download
nodes.desc: The bill download offers an Agent Copy and a Customer Copy; the Agent Copy is produced either as a summarised format without the usage view or as a masked format, each enabled or disabled by configuration.

nodes.label: Masking Rule Configuration
nodes.desc: Masking rules are configurable without requiring invoice regeneration for rules applied at the point of presentation.

nodes.label: Invoice Presented per Access Policy
nodes.desc: The correct invoice presentation (full or masked) has been delivered to the requesting user per role-based access policy.

nodes.label: Reprint Request from Siebel CRM
nodes.desc: A reprint request carries the account number, bill period and bill type and originates from Siebel CRM.

nodes.label: Retrieve XML & Regenerate PDF
nodes.desc: Reprint does not alter the original invoice data; only a previously generated bill may be reprinted, with Detailed or Summarised bill type and English or Arabic language selection.

nodes.label: Transfer PDF via Mediation Zone
nodes.desc: The reprinted PDF is transferred through the Mediation Zone to the requesting channel.

nodes.label: Reprint/Resend Registers
nodes.desc: Reprint and resend requests are displayed in dedicated console registers with status and process date.

nodes.label: Resend Request from Siebel CRM
nodes.desc: A resend request carries the account number and bill reference; only a previously generated invoice may be resent.

nodes.label: Apply Resend Email Template
nodes.desc: The resend email template may differ from the first-time bill email template and is separately maintainable in English and Arabic.

nodes.label: Despatch Resend Email
nodes.desc: The resend invoice is despatched and the delivery status is recorded and visible.

nodes.label: Preserve Existing Interface Signatures
nodes.desc: The existing reprint and resend interface signatures remain unchanged to support parallel running and to avoid impact to current channels.

nodes.label: Batch/Bill Cycle Complete
nodes.desc: Invoice emails for the batch have been despatched, completing the batch processing lifecycle.
